[LSER.13.15] **`capacity` under `realtime`.** The contract's per-series
capacity ([RTCT.7.1]) bounds the count [LSER.13.14] states, and wins. The
compiler must refuse a declared `capacity` above the contract's
(`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_CAPACITY_EXCEEDS_CONTRACT`); a series that declares none
takes the contract's.
